name: auth-token-generator
description: Generates MoQT authentication tokens for specific actions, namespaces, and tracks using a key ID, secret, and service name.

parameters.label: Auth Service
parameters.description: Service name used when issuing the token.

parameters.label: Auth Key ID
parameters.description: Key ID used for issuing the token.

parameters.label: Auth Secret
parameters.description: The secret key associated with the Key ID.

parameters.label: Auth Actions
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of permitted actions. Supported: client_setup, server_setup, publish_namespace, subscribe_namespace, subscribe, request_update, publish, fetch, track_status.

parameters.label: Auth Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace to authorize the actions against.

parameters.label: Auth Track
parameters.description: The track to authorize the actions against.
